draft.title: Switching from Ollama to llama.cpp with Open WebUI: Practical for local LLM management?
draft.body:
A Reddit user shared their experience from mid-2025 about moving away from Ollama while still using Open WebUI as a frontend for local LLMs. Their setup relies on llama.cpp or ik_llama.cpp for inference on both Linux and Windows, which they found easier and faster to configure than expected. 

Given this, the main tradeoff seems to be between Ollama’s integrated environment and the modular approach of llama.cpp plus Open WebUI. However, the original report doesn’t detail hardware or performance metrics, leaving open questions about efficiency or ease of use across different systems. 

Has anyone else tried replacing Ollama with llama.cpp and Open WebUI? What practical challenges or benefits did you encounter, especially regarding setup complexity and model compatibility?
